## Verdict: block

10 of 37 findings must be fixed before merge. The blocking set is small, cheap (mostly `effort: small`/`quick`), and concentrated in three places: `src/date.ts`, the refund path in `src/billing.ts`, and two machine-specific literals in `src/api/files.ts`.

### How I'm reading the scores

Two calibration notes that shape every call below:

- **`churn`, `blast_radius`, `blast_radius_importers`, and `recency` are `0` on all 37 findings.** That's expected against an empty baseline — there's no history to measure and no prior importers. It does *not* mean nothing imports these files. So the ranking here collapses to `severity × confidence × agent_risk`, and I weight `confidence` heavily since it's the only independent signal left.
- **`agent_risk` is compressed into 0.08–0.44.** Nothing in this repo scores as high-agent-risk in absolute terms, so I treat it comparatively: ≥0.38 is "top third of this PR", not "dangerous in general". Where `agent_risk` and `severity` disagree, I say which one I'm following and why.

Also: `suppressed_count: 1` (the gap at `crime_00021`). A suppression that predates review needs to be justified in the PR, not inherited silently.

---

## Block merge (10)

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Why it blocks |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00017` | Localhost-on-Disk | medium 0.6 / 0.30 | `/Users/andrew/dev/crimes/schema.json` @L9. Confidence 0.9, effort `quick`. Severity understates this: the code works on exactly one laptop and fails on every CI runner and every other dev. Non-negotiable, one-line fix. |
| `crime_00016` | Dev-Server URL | medium 0.6 / 0.30 | `localhost:3000` @L8, same file, same class of defect, same `quick` effort. Ships broken to every non-dev environment. |
| `crime_00001` | Temporal Recklessness | **high 0.8** / **0.44** | Highest `agent_risk` in the report, 8 clock reads across `src/date.ts`. This is the module's whole design, and it's the cheapest to fix now (`effort: small`) — it only gets more expensive once callers accumulate. |
| `crime_00010` | Half-UTC, Half-Local | **high 0.8** / 0.36 | `d` uses `getUTCFullYear()` @L9 and `getMonth()` @L41. Silently wrong by the host's UTC offset — the failure mode is bad data, not an exception. Confidence 0.85. |
| `crime_00012` | Timezone Roulette | medium 0.6 / 0.35 | `"2026-12-25T07:00:00"`, `"2026-12-20"` parsed with no zone marker. Confidence 0.9. Same module, same fix pass. |
| `crime_00018` | DST-Naive Day Math | medium 0.6 / 0.30 | `+ 86400000` @L52. Same module, same fix pass. |
| `crime_00015` | False Identity | medium 0.55 / 0.31 | `calculateRefundPreview` calls `saveRefundAudit` and `sendRefundEmail`. **I'm overriding the scores here** — a function named "preview" that emails customers and writes audit rows is a production incident waiting for the first caller who trusts the name. The detector can't price that; a reviewer can. |
| `crime_00020` | Logic in the Alibi | medium 0.5 / 0.30 | *"Only owners can refund enterprise plans unless billing support approves"* @L39, with `owner`/`plan`/`billing` absent from the surrounding code. An authorization rule that exists only in prose is unenforced. Pairs with `crime_00015` on the same refund path — together they're the riskiest surface in the PR. |
| `crime_00005` | God Function | **high 0.9** / 0.38 | `generateInvoice`, 204 lines, 3.4× threshold, confidence 0.95, effort `small`. Highest severity in the report. New code on an empty baseline is the one moment splitting this is free. |
| `crime_00025` | Test That Proves Nothing | medium 0.45 / 0.27 | `"renders the enterprise plan"` has **zero** assertions. Blocking because of an interaction the per-finding scores can't see: `crime_00005` and `crime_00013` both report `test_gap: 0` for `billing.ts` — but its only two tests are `crime_00025` (no asserts) and `crime_00034` (weak matchers). Effective coverage on a 204-line invoice generator is ~nil. Treat `test_gap: 0` on `billing.ts` as unreliable throughout this report. |

**The date cluster** (`00001`, `00010`, `00012`, `00018`, plus warn-tier `00026`/`00027`) is one review comment, not six: `src/date.ts` reads the clock non-deterministically, mixes time domains, parses zoneless strings, and does ms-arithmetic on days. Fix it as a single module rewrite behind an injected clock.

---

## Warn (19) — merge acceptable, ticket required

**Multiple-sources-of-truth cluster** — the `agent_risk` differentiator earning its keep:

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00007` | Route Metadata Drift | medium 0.6 / 0.38 | `/settings/billing` labelled 4 ways (`PricingPage` / `Plans` / `Subscription` / `Billing`). Confidence 0.65 — the detector is inferring, so verify before mandating. |
| `crime_00006` | Duplicated Navigation Source | medium 0.6 / 0.38 | Same destination, two nav files, two labels. Same root cause as above. |
| `crime_00004` | String Sprinkles | medium 0.5 / 0.42 | `"enterprise"` in 4 files across 4 areas. Fourth copy is the tell — the fifth becomes a policy bug. |
| `crime_00019` | Concept Alias Drift | medium 0.55 / 0.30 | tenant / account / organisation / team / workspace across 5 files. `suggested_action.risk: medium` — a rename touches routes; ticket it rather than rushing it in. |

**Correctness and hygiene, not urgent:**

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00032` | SVG With Embedded Raster | **high 0.75** / 0.24 | Deliberately *not* blocking despite the second-highest severity — confidence 0.95, but the impact is asset weight, and `agent_risk` 0.24 correctly says no correctness or edit-safety consequence. High severity alone doesn't block. |
| `crime_00003` | Missing Agent Context | medium 0.6 / 0.42 | No `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`, and `package.json` declares a `bin` agents can't discover. Repo-level, not PR-level; ticket separately. |
| `crime_00013` | Temporal Recklessness | medium 0.6 / 0.34 | 7 clock reads in `billing.ts`. Follows naturally from the `crime_00001` clock injection. |
| `crime_00002` | Return Shape Roulette | low 0.3 / **0.43** | Second-highest `agent_risk` on a *low*-severity finding — 3 return shapes, 0% key overlap. Exactly the case where severity misleads and `agent_risk` is right. Warn, not block, only because `petty.ts` is peripheral. |
| `crime_00008` | Sync I/O in Hot Path | low 0.4 / 0.38 | 3 blocking calls in `loadPlanSchema`, confidence 0.9. Real, mechanical, cheap. |
| `crime_00009` | Option Bag Junk Drawer | low 0.3 / 0.38 | 6 implicit property reads off an untyped bag. |
| `crime_00014` | Unfinished Business | medium 0.4 / 0.32 | 411.8 markers/1k LOC in `src/todo.ts` — 41× threshold. Signals the file isn't finished; confirm it's meant to ship. |
| `crime_00034` | Test That Proves Nothing | low 0.25 / 0.23 | Weak matchers on `"creates an invoice"`. Rides along with the `crime_00025` fix. |
| `crime_00026` | Date String Sewing | low 0.3 / 0.26 | In `src/date.ts` — free ride-along with the blocking cluster. |
| `crime_00027` | Host-Locale Drift | low 0.3 / 0.26 | Same file, same ride-along. |
| `crime_00029`–`31` | Orphaned Destination ×3 | low 0.4 / 0.26 | `/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members` unreachable. Confidence 0.65 — likely in-flight work, so a question for the author, not a gate. But three orphans plus `crime_00019`'s alias drift suggests three half-built versions of the same page. |
| `crime_00033` | Docs-Code Drift | low 0.35 / 0.24 | `docs/teams.md:5 → ./setup.md` missing. Confidence 0.9 — deterministic, one-line fix, and agents follow it. |
| `crime_00037` | Oversized Raster | low 0.4 / 0.14 | 253.9 KB, bottom rung of the ladder (low ≥ 200 KB). Follow-up ticket. |

## Ignore (8)

| ID | Charge | Sev / agent_risk | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| `crime_00035` | God File | medium 0.6 / **0.18** | 311 lines against a 300 threshold — **1.0×**. Derivative of `crime_00005`: extracting `generateInvoice`'s helpers drops the file under threshold on its own. Don't raise it as a separate change. |
| `crime_00023` | Temporal Recklessness | low 0.35 / 0.28 | One `Date.now()` in `state.ts`. Sweep it up with the clock injection; not worth its own comment. |
| `crime_00022` | Unprefixed Boolean | low 0.3 / 0.29 | `paid`/`expired`/`stale`. Taste. |
| `crime_00028` | Unprefixed Boolean | low 0.3 / 0.26 | `disableBilling`/`skipRetry`. Taste. |
| `crime_00011` | Negative Flag Maze | low 0.25 / 0.36 | `!disableBilling && !skipRetry`. Two negatives is legible; four wouldn't be. Revisit if the condition grows. |
| `crime_00024` | Plural Mismatch | low 0.3 / 0.28 | Confidence 0.7, and the finding self-declares "v1 detector — type aliases and generic types are silently skipped." Low confidence + acknowledged blind spot = not review currency. |
| `crime_00036` | Icon-Sized Raster | low 0.35 / 0.16 | 32×32 PNG. Asset-pipeline preference. |
| `crime_00038` | Unfinished Business | low 0.2 / **0.08** | 4 markers at 12.9/1k LOC — barely over a 10 threshold, lowest `agent_risk` in the report. Noise. |

## What I'd write in the PR

> Three things before I can approve. **(1)** `src/api/files.ts` has my home directory and `localhost:3000` hardcoded — CI won't run this. **(2)** `src/date.ts` needs one pass: inject a clock, pick UTC or local and stay there, add zone markers to the two date literals, drop the `86400000`. **(3)** `calculateRefundPreview` sends email and writes an audit row — rename it or extract the effects, and encode the owner/enterprise rule from the L39 comment as a real guard.
>
> Also please split `generateInvoice` (204 lines) and put a real assertion in `"renders the enterprise plan"` — it currently has none, so `billing.ts` is effectively untested.
>
> Everything else is a ticket. Flagging separately: the `/settings/billing` route is labelled four different ways across nav, metadata, and the component name, and there are three unreachable routes (`/account/subscription`, `/team`, `/workspace/members`) — are those in flight?

One process note: the scan reports `suppressed_count: 1`. Worth confirming that suppression is intentional and documented before merging, since nothing in the review surfaces what it hid.
